lines: du ſeruice de ſon maiſtre {b}, A plus grãde raiſon, de gaſter,
& ſeduire par dons, preſens, blãdices, Promeſſes, & autre
tels alechemens, vne perſonne franche, & libre: meſme-
ment ſi coniointe, qu'vne fẽme, ou vn enfãt {c}, plus chers
ſans cõparaiſon au mari, ou au pere, qu'a toutes les cho-
ſes les plus precieuſes du monde {d}.
Et diſcourant mieux encor le faict, deſ-
duiſoit, qu'ayant demeuré ſept ou huict
ans, au ſeruice du Roy à la guerre, & quel
ques mois aux Eſpaignes pour voir le
pays, deſireux de reuoir ſes parens, ſa pa-
trie, Sanxi ſon enfant, & plus encor ladite
de Rols ſa femme: ſ'en ſeroit trois ans y
a & d'auantage, retourné audit lieu d'Ar-
tigat.
Ces trois eſguillions ici, eſtoyent à la verité biens
poignans, pour faire reuenir vn perſonnage de loing
tain pais; à ſçauoir La douceur de la partie, La charité
des enfans, & L'amour de la femme. Car quant à la pa-
trie: à peine pourroit-on exprimer (dit en quelque lieu
Ciceron) ce qu'elle contient de douceur, de plaiſir d'a-
mour, & de volupté {a}. laquelle infiniment grande, fait
qu'vn autre pays, bien qu'il ſoit plus beau, plaiſant, &
fertile, ne ſera pourtant iamais trouué ſi gracieux, ni
delectable {b2}. teſmoing Vliſſes, lequel iadis oſa bien pre
ferer Ithaque (d'ou il eſtoit natif) pierreuſe aſsiſe com
me vn petit nid parmi les apres rochers, & preſqu' in-
acceſſible à l'ĩmortalité, que Calypſo la nymphe luy a-
uoit offeret {c2}. Auquel propos Ouide dit {q},
Neſcio qua natale ſolum, dulcedine cunctos
Ducit, & immemores, non ſinit eſſe ſui.

uncertain.text: uoit offeret {c2}. Auquel propos Ouide dit {q},
uncertain.note: the marker after 'Ouide dit' is printed as an italic q (bowl and straight descender); both readers and the reconciler agree. No note is keyed q; the note keyed d2 ('Ouid. au j. de Ponto.') is evidently the note for it, and d is the letter the restarted alphabet a, b2, c2 wants. Wrong sort; transcribed as printed per the standing ruling, and linked to margin_notes[6].
note key d2 has no {d2} marker in the body: its marker is the one printed as {q} on blocks[4].lines[13] (wrong sort for d). See that entry.

uncertain.text: uoit offeret {c2}. Auquel propos Ouide dit {q},
tain pais; à ſçauoir La douceur de la partie, La charité
uncertain.note: semicolon after 'pais' confirmed at 7x (lower mark has a tail), where the sense would suggest a colon.
'rit-' (continuing 'tre.' on the next line) is sic for 'tit-/tre' = titre; the first sort is read as r rather than t at 8x, though the small italic is blurred.

key numbering: the alphabet restarts at the ANNOTAT. XVI. head, so the page carries two b/c/d notes. The first set (paragraph continued from p030) keeps b, c, d; the restarted set is a, b2, c2, d2 per §4.

the last sort is shaped like an italic capital I (flat serifs top and bottom, shorter than the lowercase l earlier in the same line); the sense of the citation wants 'ad l. Falc.' (ad legem Falcidiam). Transcribed as printed, 'I.'

a small isolated ink mark sits above the baseline between 'Falc.' and 'de'. It has no foot or descender, so it is read as stray ink / a failed sort and not transcribed; it could be a badly printed 'l.'
the punctuation after 'finale' is faint and worn; read as a period, but a comma or colon is possible.
reads 'can.' (c-a-n); the citation is D. quod metus causa, so 'cau.' would be expected. Transcribed as printed; sic.

uncertain.note: the word-break sign in 'pourroit-on' is printed as a raised round dot rather than the usual hyphen; transcribed as '-' per §2.

uncertain.text: ment ſi coniointe, qu'vne fẽme, ou vn enfãt {c}, plus chers
uncertain.note: the mark over the e of 'fẽme' is a flat wavy bar, read as a tilde (= femme) and not as the acute of 'féme'; the tilde over the a of 'enfãt' on the same line has the same shape.

uncertain.note: 'ce qu'elle' is set solid with no gap in the print; split into two words per §1 word division.

uncertain.text: me vn petit nid parmi les apres rochers, & preſqu' in-
uncertain.note: the compositor sets a clear word space after the apostrophe of 'preſqu'', with 'in-' hyphenated to 'acceſſible' on the next line. Kept as printed ('preſqu' in-') rather than closed up to 'preſqu'in-'.

uncertain.note: 'aſsiſe' confirmed at 4x: long ſ followed by a round s, then i, ſ, e.

'ad I.' confirmed at 4x: the last sort is a bold italic capital I with flat serifs top and bottom, not the looped lowercase l that opens the line; the sense wants 'ad l. Falc.' Transcribed as printed.

decisions.A: uoit offerte {c2}. Auquel propos Ouide dit {q},
decisions.B: uoit offeret {c2}. Auquel propos Ouide dit {q},
decisions.text: uoit offeret {c2}. Auquel propos Ouide dit {q},
decisions.reason: At 3.5x the sorts read o-ff-e-r-e-t: the sixth letter is a round e and the seventh a t with crossbar, followed by the raised marker. 'offeret' is a transposition for 'offerte'; transcribed as printed (sic).

At 6-8x the first sort is a short italic r (stem with a top-right flag, no crossbar), unlike the t two letters on, which carries a crossbar on both sides; it matches the r of 'ſer.' on the line below. 'rit-/tre' is sic for 'tit-/tre' (titre).
At 7x nothing follows the ſ of 'Odiſ' but its own top hook; no hyphen is printed before the break to 'ſee.' (a common unhyphenated break in this print).
